---
mode: ask
description: Audit a selected module for duplication, missing boundary validation, and repository-rule violations without changing files.
---

Review the selected file without editing it. Report:

- Duplicated logic and where it appears.
- Missing checks for boundary values and malformed input.
- Violations of the rules in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

For each finding, explain the impact and cite the relevant file and line. Do not modify code.
